evidence.observation: At growth entry, temperature transiently overshoots the 750 °C setpoint to 760.2 °C while heater power falls to 38.3%.
Temperature settles toward setpoint at 752.0 °C with heater power 41.1%, consistent with recovery from the ramp-to-growth transition.
Argon is 100.2 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint, pressure remains stable at 3.024 Torr, oxygen is low at 4.2 ppm, and status is running.

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth sample characterization is required to determine whether the target material grew.
